newsitem.title: INDONESIA: S.Africa's Mandela invites Suharto on state visit.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mandela invites Suharto on state visit.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela said on Tuesday he had invited Indonesia's President Suharto to pay a state visit.
"I expect him from any time from January next year...we want him to visit our country at his earliest possible convenience," Mandela told a news conference winding up his state visit to Indonesia.

He said he was grateful to Suharto and the government and people of Indonesia for supporting the African National Congress (ANC) after it was legalised in 1990 and before it became the ruling party in 1994.
Mandela said he had first visited Indonesia following his release from prison in 1990 to gain support for the ANC. He came to Jakarta in 1994 on a similar mission.
Mandela arrived in Jakarta in Monday and was due to leave for Bangkok on Wednesday before returning to South Africa.
